facts.fact: Consumers have spent over $17 billion on Small Business Saturday in recent years, according to an American Express source cited by the page.
facts.quote: consumers have spent over [$17 billion on Small Business Saturday](https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/business/trends-and-insights/articles/shop-small-small-business-saturday/)

facts.fact: Adwave platform pricing starts at $50 for small businesses running TV ads, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: with [platforms like Adwave](https://adwave.com/pricing/) starting at $50, small businesses can play the same game.

facts.fact: The page states that 67% of consumers trust TV advertising more than social media ads, citing a resource on why customers trust TV brands.
facts.quote: [67% of consumers trust TV advertising](https://adwave.com/resources/why-customers-trust-tv-brands/) more than social media ads.

facts.fact: For a total Small Business Saturday marketing budget of $200-500, the suggested TV advertising allocation is $100-200 for a 2-week run.
For a total Small Business Saturday marketing budget of $200-500, the suggested social media boost allocation is $50-100.
For a total Small Business Saturday marketing budget of $200-500, the suggested in-store materials allocation is $50-100.
For a total Small Business Saturday marketing budget of $500-1,000, the suggested TV advertising allocation is $300-500 for a 3-week run with higher frequency.
For a total Small Business Saturday marketing budget of $500-1,000, the suggested social media allocation is $100-200.
For a total Small Business Saturday marketing budget of $500-1,000, the suggested local partnerships/events allocation is $100-200.
For a total Small Business Saturday marketing budget of $500-1,000, the suggested print/signage allocation is $100.
The recommended campaign timeline launches awareness-focused TV ads 2 weeks before Small Business Saturday.
The recommended campaign shifts TV creative to promote Small Business Saturday specials 1 week before the event.
The page's action checklist says to plan the offer, create TV ad creative, and brief the team at least 3 weeks before Small Business Saturday.
The page was published on November 11, 2025.
AdWave says a Small Business Saturday TV ad can start at $50.
facts.quote: Starting at $50, there's no reason not to be part of the biggest day for local businesses.

facts.fact: AdWave's guide says a focused local TV campaign for Small Business Saturday can start at $500-1,500 for the 2-3 week period.
facts.quote: A focused local TV campaign can start at $500-1,500 for the 2-3 week period.

facts.fact: AdWave recommends starting TV advertising 2-3 weeks before Small Business Saturday.
facts.quote: Start TV advertising 2-3 weeks before Small Business Saturday to build awareness.

facts.fact: AdWave says many successful Small Business Saturday campaigns launch in mid-November.
facts.quote: Many successful campaigns launch mid-November to capture early holiday shoppers while peaking on the weekend itself.

facts.fact: AdWave recommends increasing TV ad frequency in the final week before Small Business Saturday.
facts.quote: Increase frequency in the final week.
